HEIMWEE is looking for customer service interns for their 3 brands:
 
 

• MXDVS 

• Objects by Max Reynders 

• Garments by Max Reynders  

 
 

We work across clothing and furniture. As a small, hands-on team, everyone's work has a direct impact on how our brands look, feel, and grow.
 

We're looking for a Customer Service Intern to join us on-site and and be the friendly voice behind our three brands. You'll be the first point of contact for customers and helping us keep the same care and attention we put into our products in every conversation.
 

 
 

What you'll do
 
 

• Answer customer questions via email, social media, and/or live chat across our three brands 

• Help resolve order issues: shipping questions, returns, exchanges, and order tracking 

• Keep customers informed and reassured, even when something's gone wrong 

• Log and flag recurring issues so the team can spot patterns and improve processes 

• Support with maintaining FAQs and help-center content as our brands and product lines grow 

• Work closely with the operations and marketing teams to make sure customer feedback is heard  

 
 

What we're looking for
 
 

• Currently studying business, communication, or a related field (or recently graduated) 

• Strong written communication skills and a genuine, patient, customer-first attitude 

• Organized and comfortable managing multiple conversations at once 

• Interest in fashion, design, or furniture is a plus 

• Fluent in English  

 
 

What we offer
 
 

• Hands-on experience across three distinct brands, from strategy to execution 

• Real responsibility: you'll be trusted to represent Heimwee in every interaction 

• Insight into how a multi-brand company in fashion and furniture actually operates  

 
 

How to apply
 

Send your CV to joske@maxreynders.com. We're excited to hear from you.

HEIMWEE is looking for Supply Chain Management interns for their 3 brands:
 
 

• MXDVS 

• Objects by Max Reynders 

• Garments by Max Reynders  

 
 

We work across clothing and furniture. As a small, hands-on team, everyone's work has a direct impact on how our brands look, feel, and grow.
 

We're looking for a Supply Chain Management Intern to join us on-site and help keep production and logistics running smoothly across our three brands. From fabric to furniture, you'll get hands-on exposure to how a multi-brand company sources materials, coordinates production, and gets finished products to customers on time.
 

 
 

What you'll do
 
 

• Support day-to-day coordination with suppliers and production partners across our brands 

• Help track purchase orders, lead times, and delivery schedules 

• Monitor stock levels and assist with inventory planning to avoid shortages or overstock 

• Support the coordination of shipments and logistics, both inbound (materials) and outbound (orders to customers) 

• Help identify bottlenecks in the supply chain and suggest improvements 

• Maintain accurate records of suppliers, orders, and stock 

• Work closely with the operations, marketing, and customer service teams to align on product availability  

 
 

What we're looking for
 
 

• Currently studying supply chain management, logistics, business, or a related field 

• Organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable working with data and spreadsheets 

• Interest in production and sourcing, ideally in fashion and/or furniture 

• Proactive problem-solver who's comfortable coordinating with multiple parties 

• Fluent in English  

 
 

What we offer
 
 

• Hands-on experience across three distinct brands, from strategy to execution 

• Real responsibility and visibility into how products move from supplier to customer 

• Insight into how a multi-brand company in fashion and furniture actually operates  

 
 

How to apply
 

Send your CV to joske@maxreynders.com. We're excited to hear from you.

The 
Product Manager will lead and manage the product line using a market-based approach. This role will develop and manipulate the product line plans globally for the division. This role also encompasses end-to-end product line ownership including product and market strategy deployment, product roadmap development, and overall product line management.
 

The ideal candidate should:
 
 

• Possess strong skills in conducting business and market assessments, evaluating business strategies and demonstrating excellent communication abilities to effectively develop and present their recommendations among Sales, Finance, Product Marketing and Communications. 

• Demonstrate fluency in stage-gate product development processes, pricing strategy, and cross-functional product commercialization.  

Key domains:
 

Portfolio & product lifecycle management and innovation.
 

Market intelligence & competitive strategy.
 

Business cases & financial accountability.
 

Go-to-market strategy & sales enablement.
 

Customer & market development.

 

• Minimum of 5 years of progressive experience in product management, product marketing or commercial management. 

• Experience in packaging, specialty chemicals or other manufacturing industry required. 

• Experience working across multiple regions or global organizations is preferred. 

• Bachelor’s degree is required - Master is preferred. 

• Ability to travel up to 50%. 

• Strong analytical and qualitative assessment skills. 

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills (Dutch | English | French). 

• Acute attention to detail with ability to assess at macro level. 

• Demonstrate initiative, integrity and results-oriented mindset. 

• Ability to work effectively in a cross-functional team environment. 

• Demonstrated ability to develop and defend strategy, build product roadmaps, and present investment recommendations to senior leadership. 

• Strong financial acumen including profit management, cost structure analysis, and business case development. 

• Strong knowledge of Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint and Word. 

• Experience with ERP systems, CRM platforms, and project management tools, preferred.

Our client is a globally recognized technology and engineering company that develops innovative solutions for the food, pharmaceutical, and process industries. As a Senior Automation Software Engineer, you will play a key role in delivering advanced automation projects that drive efficiency, digitalization, and sustainability.

• Take ownership of all software-related activities within complex automation projects.

• Develop, implement, test, install, and maintain industrial software solutions in line with quality and validation standards.

• Prepare software validation documentation while ensuring projects are delivered efficiently in terms of cost, quality, and timing.

• Act as the technical point of contact for internal teams and external stakeholders regarding software-related matters.

• Contribute to innovative technologies that help optimize production processes and support a more sustainable future.

Our client is looking for an experienced automation professional who combines strong technical expertise with a proactive and solution-oriented mindset.

• Bachelor’s degree in Electronics, Software Engineering, or equivalent through experience.

• Minimum 10+ years of experience in automation and industrial software development.

• Strong knowledge of TIA Portal, SCL, STL, LAD, and SQL.

• Experience with Schneider Drives is considered a strong asset.

• Knowledge of .NET is a valuable plus.

• Fluent in English; Dutch language skills are an advantage.

• Willing to work 3 days per week on-site in the Halle or Wommelgem area.

• Strong communication skills, analytical thinking, and the ability to work independently on complex projects.

What will you do?

In this role, you combine headhunting top talent with actively building your own client portfolio. You will have the unique opportunity to write our success story in Zaventem right from the ground floor:

• 

Build Your Business: Proactively reach out to corporate clients across the region to map out their recruitment needs and develop long-lasting business partnerships.

• 

Find & Connect: Target and headhunt top talent using LinkedIn Recruiter, job boards, modern AI tools, and our existing network.

• 

Assess & Match: Conduct in-depth interviews to uncover candidates' career ambitions and match them with the right company culture.

• 

Drive Results: Manage the entire recruitment lifecycle from start to finish — from initial client acquisition to contract negotiation and candidate onboarding.

     
Who are you?

No prior recruitment background? That’s completely fine! We look for professionals with the right mindset and strong commercial instinct.

• 

Education: You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree (in any field).

• 

Language Skills: You are fluent in French and have a strong professional command of English. Good knowledge of Dutch is a clear advantage for our office dynamic.

• 

Commercial Drive: You are target-oriented, proactive on the phone, and motivated by tangible financial and professional growth.

• 

Profile: You combine sharp business acumen with high energy, resilience, and a drive to win.

Do you dream of a job with no routine work, where you build a unique finished product from A to Z? For a stable and valued family-owned company in the region, we are looking for a mature Structural Metal Worker / Fitter.

 

As a Structural Metal Worker, you are responsible for the full assembly and custom fitting directly onto the truck chassis:

• Reading Blueprint Plans & Preparation: You read complex technical drawings and bending diagrams like second nature. You saw, drill, cut, and work with lasers based on these plans.
• Assembly & Fitting: You assemble parts with precision down to the millimeter. Think of constructing stairs, doors, frames, and specific structures.
• Metalworking & Bending: You perform the necessary bending and drilling work. Logical reasoning is essential here: when a drawing is challenging, you know exactly how to make the parts fit together seamlessly.
• Light Welding: A small part of your duties includes MIG/MAG welding (assembling/tack welding). However, the main focus is on total assembly.

 Jouw profiel als Constructiemedewerker / Samensteller.

• Experience & Maturity: You have already gained solid and relevant experience in metal construction, assembly, or fitting (e.g., custom doors, stairs, or structures). Due to the complexity of the work, we are looking for a mature candidate who can work independently.
• Technical Insight: You excel at reading blueprint drawings, have excellent spatial awareness, and can reason logically.
• Metalworking Skills: You have experience with various metalworking techniques (drilling, bending, cutting). Experience with or training in MIG/MAG welding is a nice plus, but not a requirement!
• Language Skills: You communicate fluently in English.

As a Team Leader – Production, you play a key role in our manufacturing operations. You are responsible for coordinating the daily production activities while leading and supporting your team. By combining a people-oriented leadership style with a focus on quality, safety, and continuous improvement, you help achieve production targets and maintain the highest quality standards.

Your Responsibilities:

• Lead, coach, and motivate operators on the production line.
• Foster a positive, respectful, and collaborative team environment.
• Monitor and continuously improve quality, safety, and workplace organisation.
• Oversee the daily production schedule and ensure the production line operates efficiently.
• Manage stock levels and ensure the correct use of materials.
• Work with production software and ERP systems, including Iris and Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central.
• Perform basic administrative tasks and prepare production reports.
• Communicate effectively in either Dutch or English with colleagues and stakeholders.

Are You the Team Leader We're Looking For?

• You have strong leadership and coaching skills and know how to inspire a team.
• You communicate confidently, clearly, and with a positive attitude.
• You are comfortable working with computer systems and quickly adapt to new software.
• You work accurately and have a strong focus on quality, safety, and efficiency.
• You are fluent in Dutch and/or English.
• Experience in a manufacturing or production environment is an advantage.

As a Van Driver & Logistics Operator, you are the link between our workshop and our customers. You will be responsible for carrying out daily logistics operations across Brussels and throughout Belgium, ensuring that every customer receives a scooter that meets our quality standards.

You will be one of the faces of MUTE on the road and will play a key role in delivering an exceptional customer experience.

Your Responsibilities

Deliveries & Collections

• Deliver electric scooters to customers.
• Collect scooters requiring maintenance or repairs.
• Carry out vehicle swaps when needed.
• Load and unload scooters safely and efficiently.
Logistics Operations

• Optimize routes to maximize operational efficiency.
• Keep the company van clean, organized and in good condition.
• Report any damage or operational issues concerning transported vehicles.
Customer Service

• Represent MUTE professionally during every customer interaction.
• Introduce customers to the basic operation of their scooter upon delivery.
• Answer basic customer questions.
• Ensure every delivery reflects the high service standards of MUTE.
Operational Support

When deliveries are completed, you will support the workshop and logistics team by:

• Moving scooters within the warehouse.
• Preparing vehicles for delivery.
• Cleaning and inspecting scooters.
• Charging and handling batteries safely.
• Assisting the operations team based on daily priorities. 
We are looking for someone who is reliable, proactive and enjoys working independently.

Requirements

• Valid Category B driving licence (mandatory).
• Comfortable driving a delivery van in urban environments.
• Reliable, punctual and well organized.
• Careful with equipment and company vehicles.
• Able to work independently while maintaining high quality standards.
• Physically fit, as the role involves loading and unloading electric scooters.
Preferred Qualifications

• Previous experience in logistics, deliveries or transportation.
• Interest in electric vehicles or sustainable mobility.
• Experience in the mobility, automotive or technical sector is a plus.
• Good knowledge of Brussels and surrounding areas.
Languages

• Good command of English and French.
• Dutch is an advantage but is not required. 
What We Offer

• 6-month full-time contract (38 hours per week), with the possibility of a permanent contract (CDI) based on performance and business needs.
• A dynamic and fast-growing company.
• A young, international and supportive team.
• A varied role with a high level of autonomy.
• Competitive salary based on experience, plus additional benefits.

·
 Behavioral skills:
